instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand racked on your shoulders with elbows up.
2. Keep your chest tall and step forward with your right leg.
3. Bend both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee is just above the ground.
4. Push through your right heel to return to standing.
5. Repeat on the left leg, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the dumbbells racked tight to your shoulders with elbows pointing forward.
2. Brace your core to stay upright and resist twisting.
3. Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
4. Push through the front heel, not the toes.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand resting against your thighs, palms facing back.
2. Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height with arms nearly straight.
3. Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
4. Lower the dumbbells slowly back to your thighs.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Use a controlled tempo and do not swing the weights.
2. Keep your torso still and core braced.
3. Stop at shoulder height to keep tension on the front delts.
4. Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand racked on your shoulders with elbows pointing forward.
2. Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
3. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping knees in line with your toes.
4. Push through your heels to stand back up, fully extending hips and knees.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows up to hold the dumbbells stable on your shoulders.
2. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
3. Brace your core to stay upright.
4. Keep your spine neutral and chest tall.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
2. Place a dumbbell across your hips and hold it with both hands.
3. Press through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold briefly.
5. Lower your hips back down with control without resting on the floor.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive through your heels to load the glutes.
2. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
3. Keep knees aligned with toes, not splaying out.
4. Keep your spine neutral and ribs down, do not arch the lower back.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, elbows down.
2. Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
3. Descend until your thighs are just below parallel to the floor.
4. Hold the bottom position for 2 seconds with your chest up.
5. Push through your heels to stand back up and squeeze your glutes at the top.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
2. Keep your weight on your heels through the hold.
3. Stay tight in the bottom position, do not relax during the pause.
4. Keep your spine neutral and chest tall.
